device.description: 12-bit 200 kHz differential-input micropower sampling SAR ADC with synchronous serial interface
device.note: ads7817.pdf (SBAS066A) p.2 pin configuration and descriptions, p.3 specifications (VCC 4.75-5.25 V, VIH, binary two's complement), p.9 digital interface and Table I timing, p.10 Figure 4 timing and data format (Table II)

pages: p.2 (pin configuration PDIP-8/SOIC-8/MSOP-8, one pinout; pin descriptions), p.3 (VCC 4.75-5.25 V, VIH 3 V to VCC+0.3 V, binary two's complement), p.9 (Table I: tdDO 150 ns max, tdis 50 ns max, ten 100 ns max), p.10 (Figure 4, data format: 0 V differential = 000h)
notModeled: analog differential input (+In - -In, span 2 x VREF); the conversion is clocked by DCLOCK (12 clocks, not timed: the result is the 0 V code 000h at once)

DOUT is Hi-Z for the first two DCLOCK edges (sample time 1.5-2.0 clocks), then the null bit, then B11..B0; after B0 the part repeats the result LSB-first and then tri-states (text) or outputs zeros (Figure 1 note) - for the 0 V code all those bits are zeros, so idle 0 covers it
auto power-down after the conversion and shutdown while CS/SHDN is high (no visible bus effect)
throughput (200 kHz) and DCLOCK frequency limits
variants: ADS7817B/C (EB, EC, UC) are higher linearity grades of the same part (same spec). ADS7816 is the single-ended straight-binary sibling with its own datasheet.
